prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated production game prop sprite on genuine transparent alpha, original illustration.
Draw a single tall curved industrial foundry SHIELD, no character or hands. Three-quarter SIDE VIEW FACING RIGHT: outer convex armored front bows towards the RIGHT, with a narrow dark inner/back rim visible along LEFT edge. Overall shield outline tall and narrow, width approximately 44 percent of its height. A strong beveled arched top, tapered heavy bottom with softly pointed metal toe. Deep BLUE STEEL central shell, thick gunmetal bevel, prominent BRONZE / warm brass edge bands and five or six large round metal studs. One bright VERTICAL ORANGE-YELLOW FURNACE GRATE integrated in the central-right shield face, a simple single elongated glowing opening segmented by three dark crossbars. It must look like a heavy wearable foundry guard shield rather than a door, building, robot or face.
Art direction matches an original premium hand-painted cel action game: richly illustrated layered metal but BOLD large simple readable shapes, crisp strong dark outer contour, beautiful pale blue steel edge highlights from upper left, copper gold rim contrast, restrained scuffed paint, three-tone graphic material rendering. The exact final game footprint is only 38 pixels wide by 80 tall, so keep the silhouette and vertical hot grate very legible at thumbnail size. Strong clean silhouette, no tiny filigree, no smoke, no particles, no floor shadow, no additional objects, no people/humanoid, no text, no UI, no logo, no mockup.
Composition: entire single prop centered in a portrait canvas, large generous TRANSPARENT margin on every side. No background color or checkerboard painted into image. Fully isolated true transparent cutout, all metal edges complete and uncropped.
